title: Parsed Mapping Excel
description: Schema for the parsed output of the DE mapping Excel document. Produced by /de-parse-mapping.

target_table.description: Target table name (e.g. fdp_mortgage_case). May include (file:parquet) suffix when target is a parquet file — suffix is stripped during parsing, leaving only the clean table name.

table_description.description: Table-level business description, captured from first non-empty 'Target Table description' cell

additional_context.description: Table-level metadata including load_type (Day0=full/initial load, Day1/BAU=incremental, both=full_then_incremental), scheduling/frequency, crypto hints. Captured from first non-empty 'Additional Context' cell

load_type_hint.description: Load type hint extracted from additional_context keywords. Day0=full/initial load, BAU=incremental/delta, full_then_incremental=both. Null if no keywords matched. Consumed by intent-identifier-agent at Priority 1.5.

target_table_type.description: Table-level field (first non-empty value from optional 'Target Table Type' column). scd2/scd1 maps to NonTransactional; transactional maps to Transactional. Highest priority signal (Priority 0.5) for table_type intent resolution.

cdc_type_hint.description: CDC type extracted from Additional Context field. 'snapshot' = source provides full entity state (absence = deletion); 'delta' = source provides only changed/new rows (absence = unchanged). Resolved from key-value pattern 'cdc_type:snapshot|delta' or standalone keywords 'full_snapshot/snapshot/delta'. Null if not specified. Priority 0.5 for snapshot_mode resolution (takes precedence over domain knowledge).

cdc_exclude_cols_hint.description: CDC exclusion columns extracted from Additional Context field. Format: 'cdc_exclude:col1,col2,col3'. Columns listed here are excluded from CDC merge comparison. When non-null, takes full precedence over domain knowledge (transform-generator skips DK for CDC exclusions). Null if not specified.

partition_key_hint.description: Partition key columns extracted from Additional Context field. Format: 'partition_key:col1,col2'. Consumed by intent-identifier-agent at Priority 1.5 for partition_key_columns resolution. Null if not specified.

validate_unique_keys_hint.description: CDC validate_unique_keys override extracted from Additional Context field. Format: 'validate_unique_keys:true|false'. Databricks-only (consumed by run_cdc() via target_writer.py) — NOT applicable to Glue platform. When non-null, takes Priority 1 precedence over domain knowledge for cdc.validate_unique_keys in generated Databricks config. When null (not specified), gen-config defaults to false. Consumed by gen-config STEP 3 (Databricks only).

duplicates_ts_col_hint.description: CDC duplicates timestamp column extracted from Additional Context field. Format: 'duplicates_ts_col:<column_name>'. Databricks-only (consumed by run_cdc() via target_writer.py) — NOT applicable to Glue platform. When non-null, takes Priority 1 precedence over domain knowledge for cdc.duplicates_ts_col in generated Databricks config. Used by TargetWriter to order duplicate records before deduplication. Should reference a source column containing a timestamp/date. When null (not specified), field is omitted entirely from config.yml. Consumed by gen-config STEP 3 and STEP 1.5 (source column augmentation, Databricks only).

dedup_order_hint.description: CDC dedup sort order extracted from Additional Context field. Format: 'dedup_order:asc|desc'. Databricks-only (consumed by run_cdc() via target_writer.py) — NOT applicable to Glue platform. When non-null, takes Priority 1 precedence over domain knowledge for cdc.dedup_order in generated Databricks config. 'desc' = keep latest record; 'asc' = keep earliest record. When null (not specified), field is omitted entirely from config.yml. Consumed by gen-config STEP 3 (Databricks only).

process_frequency_hint.description: Process frequency extracted from Additional Context field. Format: 'process_frequency:<value>'. Cross-platform (Databricks + Glue). Databricks: emitted as pipeline.process_frequency. Glue: emitted as date_control.frequency. When non-null, takes Priority 1 precedence over domain knowledge. Default: DAILY. Consumed by gen-config STEP 3.6. Synonym: load_frequency (used in intent identification) and process_frequency are synonymous — they represent the same scheduling frequency.

workday_number_monthly_hint.description: Glue-only. Business day of month (1-based integer as string). Format: 'workday_number_monthly:<N>'. Required when frequency=ONCE_A_MONTH. Used by Glue date_control.py to compute next monthly run date. When null, defaults to empty string. Not applicable to Databricks. Consumed by gen-config STEP 3.6.

workday_number_weekly_hint.description: Glue-only. Day of week (0=Sunday, 1=Monday, ..., 6=Saturday) as string. Format: 'workday_number_weekly:<N>'. Required when frequency=WEEKLY_ONCE. Used by Glue date_control.py to compute next weekly run date. When null, defaults to empty string. Not applicable to Databricks. Consumed by gen-config STEP 3.6.

run_on_weekends_hint.description: Glue-only. Controls calendar vs business day arithmetic in date_control.py. Format: 'run_on_weekends:Y|N'. Affects ONCE_A_MONTH and ALTERNATE_DAYS frequencies only. When null, defaults to N. Not applicable to Databricks. Consumed by gen-config STEP 3.6.

run_on_bank_holidays_hint.description: Glue-only. Controls UK bank holiday skipping in date_control.py. Format: 'run_on_bank_holidays:Y|N'. Affects all frequencies. When null, defaults to N. Not applicable to Databricks. Consumed by gen-config STEP 3.6.

rolling_deletion_predicate_hint.description: Rolling deletion SQL predicate extracted from Additional Context field. Format: 'rolling_deletion_predicate:<SQL_WHERE_clause>'. Cross-platform (Databricks + Glue). Specifies the WHERE clause used by TargetWriter._rolling_delete() to prune old data after each successful write. Supports {current_business_date} template variable (interpolated at runtime as ISO date string). Example: 'rolling_deletion_predicate:dw_bus_dt < DATE_SUB(CAST(\'{current_business_date}\' AS DATE), 90)'. Applicable to Transactional and NonTransactional_SCD1 tables only — must NOT be emitted for NonTransactional_SCD2. When non-null, takes Priority 1 precedence over domain knowledge for rolling_deletion.predicate in generated config. When null (not specified), rolling_deletion section is omitted entirely from config. Consumed by gen-config STEP 3.7.

source_system_hint.description: Source system label from Additional Context (key-value: source_system:<value>). When non-null, triggers multi-source-system artifact generation — each distinct value across tables produces separate independent artifacts. Multiple source databases do NOT imply multiple source systems; only this explicit declaration does.

source_volumetrics.description: Per-source-table volumetric data from optional 'Source Volumetrics' sheet. Drives worker sizing (DTXOG/Databricks) and performance optimizations (broadcast, repartition). Null/absent if sheet not provided.

source_references.description: Fully-qualified source references. Each object ties a source column to exactly one table in one database. Assembled by parser using cascading qualification rules.

transformation_logic.description: Business Logic/Transformation Logic cell value (free-text or structured format)

transformation_type.description: Classification of transformation complexity. Direct=rename/alias, Derived=expression, Lookup=join-based, Direct - Type Cast=rename+cast. Null if optional column not present.

default_value.description: Fallback value when transformation logic yields NULL. Applied via F.coalesce(expr, F.lit(default)). Null if not specified.

key_column.description: True if this column is part of the table's primary/business key. Collected across all rows to derive primary_key_columns[] at Priority 0.5. Null if optional column not present.

join_logic_missing.description: True when source_references contains multiple distinct tables but no structured_transformation (Driver Table format) was provided. Triggers ADVISORY during parse recommending structured format. Transform generation proceeds with NL interpretation (Rule 11) — best-effort join/filter code with advisory comments. Structured format recommended for deterministic output.

extracted_join_predicates.description: Join predicates extracted verbatim from free-text transformation_logic during parsing (STEP 2.8). Used as LOCKED constraints for transform generation — prevents LLM from inferring symmetric join keys or substituting column names. Null if no joins detected, structured_transformation is present (already deterministic), or transformation_logic is null/empty.

extracted_literals.description: Literal/constant values extracted verbatim from free-text transformation_logic during parsing (STEP 2.8). Used as LOCKED constraints for transform generation — prevents LLM from substituting 'more logical' values based on column semantics. Null if no literals detected or transformation_logic is null/empty.

sourceReference.description: Fully-qualified source reference. Parser decomposes qualified names from Excel: db.table.column → {database, table, column}; table.column with known db → {database (inherited), table, column}; bare column with single source → {database, table, column (all inherited)}.

database.description: Source database name (e.g. e_ilp_db). Extracted from fully qualified db.table format in Source Table column or standalone Source Database column.

table.description: Source table name without db prefix (e.g. account_wm). Extracted from db.table or table.column qualified notation in the Excel.

column.description: Source column name without table/db prefix (e.g. payoff_balance). Extracted from db.table.column or table.column qualified notation in the Excel.

structuredTransformation.description: Parsed structured transformation logic. Populated when Business Logic column uses structured format (detected by 'Driver Table:' trigger). Null when free-text format used.

driver_table.description: Primary/driving table alias for the join sequence

driver_conditions.description: Filter conditions applied to the driver table BEFORE any joins execute. Same syntax as table_conditions (e.g., 'Filter status NOT IN (CLO,RED,WOF)', 'Filter dw_bus_dt={control_Date}', 'pick latest record based on timestamp'). Empty array if no driver-level filtering needed.

table.description: Table alias or name being joined

table_conditions.description: Pre-join filter conditions applied to this table before joining (e.g. 'Filter limit_type=Base'). Empty array if none.

join_conditions.description: Join ON clause expression (e.g. 'master_tab.acctid = table1.acctid AND table1.active = 1')

value_expression.description: Final column derivation expression applied after all joins (e.g. 'Round off the limit_amount to 2 decimal points')

sourceVolumetric.description: Volumetric profile for a single source table. Drives Day 0 sizing (estimated_size_gb), Day 1 sizing (daily_increment_size_gb), and transform optimizations (broadcast_hint).

source_database.description: Source database name — must match a source_database in mapping columns

source_table.description: Source table name — must match a source table in mapping columns

estimated_rows.description: Total row count of full table

estimated_size_gb.description: Approximate total storage size in GB (primary input for Day 0 worker sizing)

daily_increment_size_gb.description: Average daily delta size in GB (primary input for Day 1 worker sizing)

primary_key.description: Primary key column(s) of source table — comma-separated if composite (e.g. 'account_id, eff_start_date'). Used for repartition key selection and dedup logic.

partition_key.description: Partition key column(s) of source table (e.g. 'dw_bus_dt', 'active'). Used for partition pruning filter selection.

table_type.description: Source table type. NonTransactional_SCD2 = entity-state tables with SCD2 history (eff_start_date, eff_end_date, active); NonTransactional_SCD1 = entity-state tables with dw_lod_tmp/dw_upd_lod_tmp only (no temporal columns); Transactional = append-only event/fact tables partitioned by business date. Directly maps to source_table_type used for runtime filtering strategy.

broadcast_hint.description: True if analyst flags this as a small reference/decode table suitable for F.broadcast(). Auto-set to true if estimated_size_gb < 0.01.

extractedJoinPredicate.description: A join predicate extracted verbatim from free-text transformation_logic. Represents one ON clause condition (e.g., 'customer_response.customer_survey_id = wm_append_data.unique_survey_ref'). When confidence is high/medium, this becomes a LOCKED constraint that the transform-generator-agent MUST reproduce exactly — no symmetric key assumptions, no column name substitution.

left_table.description: Left-side table name or alias from the join condition (as written in transformation_logic)

left_col.description: Left-side column name (as written in transformation_logic)

operator.description: Comparison operator in the join predicate

right_table.description: Right-side table name or alias from the join condition (as written in transformation_logic)

right_col.description: Right-side column name (as written in transformation_logic). May differ from left_col — asymmetric joins are intentional and MUST NOT be 'corrected'

source_text.description: Verbatim text fragment from transformation_logic that was parsed to produce this predicate. Preserved for audit trail and human review.

confidence.description: Extraction confidence. high=both tables in source_references + unambiguous regex match. medium=one table recognized OR minor ambiguity. low=neither table recognized (advisory only, NOT locked as constraint).

extractedLiteral.description: A literal/constant value extracted verbatim from free-text transformation_logic. Represents an explicit comparison or assignment value (e.g., nps_question_indicator='Y'). When confidence is high/medium, this becomes a LOCKED constraint — the transform-generator-agent MUST use this exact value, not infer alternatives based on column semantics.

column.description: Column the literal applies to. Null for hardcoded assignments where no source column is referenced (e.g., 'Hardcode to GBP').

operator.description: Comparison or assignment operator. 'hardcode' for literal assignment instructions.

value.description: The literal value exactly as it appears in transformation_logic. String for single values, array of strings for IN/NOT IN lists, number for numeric comparisons.

source_text.description: Verbatim text fragment from transformation_logic that was parsed. Preserved for audit trail.

context.description: Where in the logic this literal appears. filter_predicate=WHERE/filter clause, case_when_condition=WHEN predicate, case_when_result=THEN value, literal_assignment=hardcode/default, join_condition_literal=literal in ON clause.

confidence.description: Extraction confidence. high=unambiguous regex match with clear value. medium=value extracted but minor context ambiguity. low=uncertain extraction (advisory only, NOT locked).

is_crypto.description: True if transformation logic contains explicit crypto signal

operation.description: tokenize (protect), detokenize (unprotect), or null if no crypto

de_name.description: Protegrity Data Element name extracted from transformation logic. Null if not extractable. Must match pattern: (UK|US|APAC)_TOK_<func>_L<d>R<d>_<type>_DE

extraction_source.description: Which detection method matched: UDF pattern, explicit Protegrity reference, or keyword-only

extraction_failed.description: True when is_crypto=true but de_name could not be extracted or validation failed. Triggers refusal.

extraction_ambiguous.description: True when both 'tokenize' and 'detokenize' keywords found. Operation defaults to 'tokenize'. Flags for manual review.
